undermined, battered, and beaten since Donald Trump retook the White House
less than two years ago.

This week in democracy saw revelations of more possible corruption, another
ICE shooting, and racism at its purest form. Here's just a taste of how Trump
and his cronies harmed democracy, undermined the Constitution, and hurt
Americans and societies worldwide over the last seven days:

#### **Saturday, Oct. 3 - Talks to End War in Ukraine Include Oil Deal Tied to
Trump Envoys**

The _New York Times_
[reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/03/us/politics/kushner-witkoff-
russia-oil-deal.html) that a multibillion-dollar oil deal has been discussed
as part of the Trump administration's negotiations with Russia to end its war
in Ukraine.

The deal, which would cover oil fields, refineries, and gas stations owned by
one of Russia's biggest energy companies, is being sought by an arm of the
U.S. government, a U.S. investor who donated $2 million to Trump-related
causes, and two Middle Eastern investor groups with ties to Steve Witkoff and
Jared Kushner - the two main U.S. negotiators to end the war in Ukraine.

#### **Sunday, Oct. 4 - On Her Last Day at DHS, Kristi Noem Secured Deal With
Political Donor**

The _Times_ also
[reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/04/us/politics/kristi-noem-planes-
donor.html) that on Kristi Noem's last day as Homeland Security secretary, the
agency signed a multi-million-dollar agreement to buy five airplanes from a
company whose owner had been one of Noem's political donors. In a statement,
Noem said "the purchase of these planes was not completed" during her tenure,
but didn't answer specific questions about the agreement.

The agreement, which saw the planes purchased at a substantial markup, came
after the company's chairman, William Walters, donated $10,000 to Noem's PAC
in 2024. During her time as Homeland Security secretary, the agency gave more
than $900 million in contracts to companies led by Walters.

#### **Monday, Oct. 5 - Trump Says He'll Pay for Ads Himself, But Won't Commit
To Reimbursing Taxpayers**

On Truth Social, Trump
[said](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117390649505706640) he
would pay for his campaign-style TV ads himself, "and with money I raised for
MAGA, INC," a pro-Trump super PAC.

Democrats, legal experts, and even some Trump officials have labeled the ads
[illegal](https://zeteo.com/p/trumps-white-house-agrees-his-midterm), with
some saying they could be an
[impeachable](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/27/us/politics/trump-ad-
government-
campaign.html?unlocked_article_code=1.EVE.LHAf.Hljy0_re-9iV&smid=tw-share)
offense.

A day after Trump's post, the White House
[said](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/06/us/politics/trump-taxpayer-funded-
ads.html) the super PAC isn't planning to reimburse taxpayers for over $10
million the government had already spent on the ads, and Trump himself refused
to commit to pay back the funds himself.

#### **Tuesday, Oct. 6 - Whistleblower Reveals Trump Wanted Protesters
Investigated By FBI**

NBC News [reported](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/fbi-
whistleblower-says-white-house-pushed-unconstitutional-probe-prote-rcna601599)
that the Trump administration ordered the FBI to investigate protesters
engaging in anti-ICE demonstrations in Los Angeles last year, according to a
whistleblower report from a former agency employee.

The [complaint](https://www.padilla.senate.gov/wp-
content/uploads/10.5.26-Senate-Whistleblower-DISCLOSURE-DOJ-FBI.pdf) alleged
that the investigations violated protesters' First Amendment rights to free
speech and peaceful assembly and also went against FBI policy. While the
whistleblower said there wasn't sufficient evidence to justify the probe, she
was told by a [colleague](https://www.theguardian.com/us-
news/2026/oct/06/trump-fbi-ice-la-protesters) that "the president wants this
investigation."

#### **Wednesday, Oct. 7 - ICE Reviewed Voter Records, Targeted Nonprofits**

Democracy Docket [reported](https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/ice-
amassed-millions-of-voter-records-in-sweeping-fraud-hunt-documents-reveal/)
that ICE obtained the voting records of tens of millions of U.S. citizens. The
agency also [investigated](https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/ice-
probed-hundreds-of-voter-registration-groups-across-the-u-s/) hundreds of
nonprofit organizations across the country last year that help people register
to vote, and considered deploying undercover agents as part of its probe.

The effort targeted nonprofits in Ohio, New Jersey, D.C., Minnesota, and
Pennsylvania, including the latter's state branch of the Council on American-
Islamic Relations - the country's largest Muslim civil rights and advocacy
organization.

#### **Thursday, Oct. 8 - ICE Shoots Man in New York**

In New York City, an ICE agent posing as a construction worker
[shot](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/08/nyregion/ice-shooting-nyc-
bronx.html) 28-year-old Oscar Belgal in the neck after firing seven rounds
into his vehicle, while a 5-year-old was in the backseat. _Wired_ later
[reported](https://www.wired.com/story/ice-agent-at-nyc-shooting-has-history-
of-alleged-violence-and-illegal-arrests/) that the agent who shot Belgal has
repeatedly been accused of unlawful arrests and excessive force, including
tackling a pregnant woman to the ground, during arrests in New York and
Minneapolis.

Meanwhile, Trump went on his [latest racist
tirade](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117407181257047860) on
Truth Social, disgustingly claiming that Somali immigrants have "taken over"
Minnesota and urging residents to "fight back." (Read more about Trump's
efforts to start a race war to win the midterms in **Zeteo 's **'[First
Draft](https://zeteo.com/p/donald-trump-is-trying-to-start-a).')

#### **Friday, Oct. 9 - Trump Renews Push to Fire Lisa Cook**

Trump [signed](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-
actions/2026/10/establishment-of-a-committee-of-inquiry-to-investigate-
allegations-of-false-statements-by-lisa-denell-cook/) a presidential memo
establishing a panel to investigate Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook over
unproven allegations of mortgage fraud she has steadfastly
[denied](https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/feds-cook-lawyers-say-
hearing-will-show-no-mortgage-fraud-case-2026-10-09/). The panel will
ultimately report to Trump on whether there is "cause" for her removal.

The latest push to fire Cook follows a[ Supreme Court
ruling](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/29/supreme-court-trump-
lisa-cook-ruling) in June allowing her to continue in her position. The
ruling, however, didn't prevent Trump from attempting to remove Cook from her
post again.
